class.name: GameplayClientPrediction
class.brief_description: Bounded owner prediction history with authoritative reconciliation.
class.description: GameplayClientPrediction numbers accepted local inputs and immediately simulates them. On an authority snapshot it discards confirmed history, restores the confirmed state, and replays only newer inputs. History and generation rate limits prevent unbounded client memory or input production.

method.name: apply_authoritative_state
method.description: Reconciles to a non-stale confirmation and reports error, correction, replay, and remaining input counts. A confirmation newer than all local history establishes a reconnect baseline and advances the next local sequence.

method.name: clear
method.description: Resets state, sequences, history, counters, and rejection information.

method.name: get_correction_count
method.description: Returns the number of confirmations whose position error exceeded the threshold.

method.name: get_last_confirmed_sequence
method.description: Returns the latest accepted authority confirmation.

method.name: get_last_rejection_reason
method.description: Returns the latest local input or snapshot rejection reason.

method.name: get_last_replayed_input_count
method.description: Returns how many unconfirmed commands the last reconciliation replayed.

method.name: get_model
method.description: Returns the movement model shared with the server.

method.name: get_predicted_state
method.description: Returns the current owner-visible predicted state.

method.name: get_unconfirmed_inputs
method.description: Returns inputs newer than the last confirmation in sequence order.

method.name: predict_input
method.description: Creates, stores, and simulates the next command, or returns null when validation or a bound rejects it.

method.name: set_initial_state
method.description: Replaces the baseline and starts the next sequence after its confirmation.

method.name: set_model
method.description: Sets the non-null movement model used for prediction and replay.

members.member: Position error above which reconciliation counts as a correction. Reconciliation itself always uses authority.
